第108章 盘点收获财富自由（第1页）
盘点收获，财富自由（盘点收获，财富自由（第22页）整整十万两。加上他原本的八十万两本金消耗后剩余的底子。这笔钱，足以在外城买下半条街的商铺，或者在黑市武装一支百人规模的精锐死士。他拿出一个黑铁铸造的方箱。将银票悉数装入，盖上铁锁。推入密室角落的暗格。第二堆。灵石。下品灵石，修仙界的绝对硬通货。一千两百块。灵石呈现半透明的乳白色。内部流转着浓郁的液态灵气。苏寒抓起一把灵石。冰凉的触感透过掌心直达四肢百骸。两块灵石相互碰撞，发出清脆悦耳的玉石轻音。他没有用来修炼。而是将其全部收入左手食指的青色空间石戒中。这种战略级资源，留在冲击境界瓶颈、或者启动大型法阵时，才是最致命的底牌。第三堆。丹药。一百多瓶用羊脂玉、紫金木打造的高阶药瓶。苏寒拔开瓶塞。逐一辨认气味与色泽。“极品回血丹，五十颗。瞬回气血。”“清灵散，三十颗。解除百毒。”“破障丹，三颗。辅助突破武道瓶颈。”他将这些丹药分门别类，摆放在精钢案台的暗格药箱内。这些战利品，省去了他未来三年内去黑市采购补给的风险。清点完毕。苏寒站起身。走向密室最深处开辟出的地下药园。长宽各一丈的巨大石盆内，铺满了一层厚厚的紫金矿渣黑土。这是他专门为那些从上古废弃药园里挖来的残羹冷炙准备的新家。解开腰间最后五个鼓鼓囊囊的储物袋。“哗啦。”成千上万株断根、死种、碳化的树叶，连同灰白色的上古药土，倾泻在石盆之中。泥土的腥气在密室内弥漫。幽冥草的黑色残根。龙血参的干瘪须子。九曜剑草焦黑的断节。以及那株最珍贵、通体漆黑如墨的雷击木残株。苏寒挽起袖子。双手插进黑土里。将这些残根一株株分开、理平。按属性和品类，均匀地栽种在紫金矿土中。泥水钻进他的指甲缝。他浑然不觉。整整忙碌了一个时辰。所有的死物被安置妥当。石盆里死气沉沉。没有一丝绿意。苏寒走到一旁。解开衣襟。从心口处，掏出那个表面布满墨绿色天然阵纹的神秘小瓶。。经过这几天的月光吸收。瓶底再次凝聚出一滴圆润饱满、翠绿欲滴的神秘液滴。庞大的生机在瓶口吞吐。苏寒走到石盆中央。将瓶口对准那株焦黑的雷击木残株周围的泥土。手腕微微倾斜。一滴绿液脱离瓶口。在半空中拉出一条翠绿色的细线。“滴答。”绿液砸在泥土上。瞬间渗入地下。寂静。三息之后。“咔嚓。”一声极其微弱的碎裂声，在安静的密室内响起。雷击木焦黑碳化的表皮，突然崩开一道发丝粗细的裂纹。裂纹中，没有死气。一抹娇嫩、翠绿、充满着狂暴生命力的幼芽，顶破了坚硬的焦炭，傲然钻出。紧接着。连锁反应爆发。龙血参的干瘪根须疯狂蠕动，扎入泥土深处疯狂吸吮养分。顶端生出红色的叶片。幽冥草的断根抽出黑紫色的茎秆。绿光在石盆底部化作蛛网般蔓延。浓郁到了极致的草木清香，瞬间盖过了密室里原本的铁锈味与土腥味。灵气在半空中液化，凝结成白色的雾滴，打湿了苏寒的练功服。满室生香。万物复苏。废土变成了真正的洞天福地。苏寒站在药池边缘。深深地吸了一口充满灵气的药香。体内那滴幽蓝色的灵力水滴，在这股药香的滋养下，欢快地旋转了一圈。财富自由。资源自由。他转过头，看向密室角落的更漏。沙漏见底。天快亮了。苏寒将掌天瓶贴身收好。洗净双手。换上那套补丁摞补丁的玄衣卫八品官服。拿过木拐，夹在左腋下。推开头顶的地道盖板。爬出地面。推开三合院摇摇欲坠的木门。清晨的冷雨打在街角的青石板上。长河州府的街道上，一队队披甲执锐的巡城军正在疯狂奔走，挨家挨户地砸门搜查。神宗与悲空寺的怒火，彻底点燃了这座州府。苏寒佝偻着背。“咳咳……咳咳咳……”他捂着嘴，拖着残腿，踏入泥泞的街道。迎接他的，将是镇抚司案牍库里，前所未有的狂风暴雨。

Inventory of Harvest, Freedom of Wealth (Inventory of Harvest, Freedom of Wealth (Page 22)) A total of one hundred thousand taels. Plus the rest of his original capital of eight hundred thousand taels after consumption. This money is enough to buy half a street of shops in the outer city, or to arm a hundred-person elite dead force in the black market. He took out a square box made of black iron. He put all the banknotes in them, covered them with iron locks, and pushed them into the secret compartment in the corner of the secret room. The second pile. Spiritual stones. Low-grade spiritual stones.修仙界的绝对硬通货。一千两百块。灵石呈现半透明的乳白色。内部流转着浓郁的液态灵气。苏寒抓起一把灵石。冰凉的触感透过掌心直达四肢百骸。两块灵石相互碰撞，发出清脆悦耳的玉石轻音。他没有用来修炼。而是将其全部收入左手食指的青色空间石戒中。这种战略级资源，留在冲击境界瓶颈、或者启动The most deadly trump card is the large magic circle. The third pile is more than a hundred high-end medicine bottles made of mutton fat jade and purple gold wood. "Qing Ling Powder, thirty pills, to remove hundreds of poisons." "Three pills to help break through martial arts bottlenecks." He placed these pills in a hidden compartment on the stainless steel table. The loot saved him the risk of going to the black market to purchase supplies in the next three years. After the inventory was completed, Su Han stood up and walked towards the underground medicine garden, which was one foot long and wide. Thick purple gold slag and black soil. This is the new home he specially prepared for the leftovers dug from the ancient abandoned medicine garden. He untied the last five bulging storage bags around his waist. "Crash." Thousands of plants were cut off and died. Plants, carbonized leaves, and gray-white ancient medicinal soil were poured into the stone basin. The smell of earth filled the secret room, along with the shriveled and blackened roots of the Netherworld Grass. And the most precious piece of lightning-struck tree stump, which was as black as ink. Su Han rolled up his sleeves and inserted his hands into the black soil. He separated the stumps one by one and planted them evenly in the purple gold soil. The water got into his nails. He had been busy for a whole hour, and there was no trace of green in the stone basin. He untied his clothes. He took out the mysterious vial with dark green natural patterns on it. After absorbing the moonlight for the past few days, a round, plump, emerald green drop of mysterious liquid formed at the mouth of the vial. Han walked to the center of the stone basin and pointed the mouth of the bottle at the soil around the charred lightning tree. He tilted his wrist slightly and pulled out a thin emerald line in the air. On the soil. It penetrated into the ground instantly. After three breaths, an extremely weak cracking sound sounded in the quiet chamber, and a crack as thick as a hair suddenly broke open. There was no life in the crack. A delicate, emerald sprout bursting through the hard char, followed by a chain reaction of shriveled roots. , piercing into the depths of the soil and sucking nutrients wildly. The broken roots of the ghost grass sprouted black and purple stems, and the green light spread like a spider web at the bottom of the stone basin, covering it with an extremely strong fragrance.The original smell of rust and earth in the secret room was gone. The spiritual energy liquefied in mid-air, condensed into white mist droplets, and wet Su Han's training clothes. The room is filled with fragrance. All things revive. The wasteland turned into a real paradise. Su Han stood on the edge of the medicine pool. He took a deep breath of the medicinal fragrance that was full of spiritual energy. The drop of blue spiritual power in the body, nourished by the medicinal fragrance, swirled happily in a circle. Wealth freedom. Resource freedom. He turned his head and looked at Geng Le in the corner of the secret room. The hourglass bottoms out. It's almost dawn. Su Han put the Zhangtian bottle close to his body. Wash your hands. Put on the Xuanyi Wei eighth-grade official uniform with lots of patches. He took the wooden crutch and put it under his left armpit. Push open the tunnel cover above your head. Climb out of the ground. Pushing open the rickety wooden door of the Sanheyuan. The cold rain in the early morning hits the bluestone on the street corner. On the streets of Changhe Prefecture, groups of armored patrols were running wildly, breaking down doors and searching houses. The anger of Shenzong and Beikong Temple completely ignited the state capital. Su Han's back was bent. "Cough cough... cough cough cough..." He covered his mouth, dragged his remaining legs, and stepped into the muddy street. What will greet him will be an unprecedented storm in the archives of the Zhenfu Division.
